section_summary.extract_value: This section discusses the limitations of the present study, focusing on the administration of words in a single order and the assignment of noun stimuli to cued or uncued conditions. It addresses the interpretation of the lack of correlations in the uncued condition, suggesting participants may have reserved creative abilities for the cued condition. The section concludes by emphasizing that the main findings, relating cued responses to diverse creativity measures, are not significantly influenced by these interpretations, and highlights the study as a first step in validating a cognitive neuroscience measure for creative abilities.
